purpose: Teach: アポロ/ライナー/ゼット/ナカ/シマ/鞭/ハンドブック/さらし

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、アポロ、絶対、計画の、絶対、本、絶対、読みたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really, really want to read the Apollo plan book.
lines.style: Bright, insistent urgency. Quick breath-catch at the start. Each emphasized word gets a little punch of intensity. No patience for doubt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、若い頃、絶対、ライナー、絶対、打つのが、絶対、得意だったって、翔くん
lines.en: Your father was really good at hitting line drives when he was young, Sho.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly distant memory. Warm but looking inward. Slow, careful pacing — selecting the words like she's reaching back. Soft close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの帽子の、絶対、ゼット、絶対、マーク、絶対、お気に入りなんだ
lines.en: Mom, I really love the Z-mark on my cap.
lines.style: Proud straightforward delivery. Chest-up posture in the voice. Direct eye contact with her. Simple and sure, no apology.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さんのお友達、本気で、絶対、ナカイ、絶対、さんって、絶対、いう方なのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your mom's friend is a woman named Nakai, Sho.
lines.style: Soft, connecting tone. Warm and present but not performing. Brief pause before the name — letting it land. Ending gently, like she's sharing something small and real.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 動物園で、本気で、絶対、シマウマ、絶対、ぼく、絶対、近くで、絶対、見たいな、ママ
lines.en: At the zoo, I really want to see the zebras up close, Mom.
lines.style: Eager, almost bouncing in the delivery. Quick pace. Eyes wide in the voice. That reaching-forward quality of a child who can't wait to tell you something.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、若い頃、絶対、馬の、絶対、鞭、絶対、上手に扱えたって、翔くん
lines.en: Your grandfather was very skilled with a horse whip when he was younger, Sho.
lines.style: Reflective, measuring her words carefully. Slight smile in the delivery — pride in the memory. Slow, deliberate pacing. A small moment of looking back.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、観察ノートの、絶対、ハンドブック、絶対、見て
lines.en: Mom, look at the handbook in my observation notebook.
lines.style: Bright, seeking approval. Eager for her attention. Quick tempo, opening with anticipation. That particular tone children use when they've made something and want you to see it right now.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、暖簾の、絶対、さらし布、絶対、白くて、絶対、清々しいわよね、翔くん
lines.en: The noren cloth at your grandfather's house is so white and fresh, isn't it, Sho.
lines.style: Tender, appreciative. Gentle rhythm, like she's noticing something small and lovely. Warm and present. Trailing softly — inviting him into the observation with her.
